observations: Photo 0: A stack of wooden pallets in an outdoor yard, some standing upright, some lying flat. The pallets appear weathered, with visible wood grain and some discoloration. A white truck is visible in the background.
Photo 1: Similar stack of pallets, with one pallet lying flat in the foreground. The pallets show signs of use and exposure to elements. A white car is visible in the background.

Photo 2: A tall stack of pallets, with multiple pallets stacked vertically. The pallets show signs of wear and some discoloration. The ground is littered with debris. A person's hand is visible on the right edge of the stack.

Photo 3: A close-up of a single wooden pallet lying on its side, showing the top and side. The pallet has vertical slats and horizontal beams. The wood appears light-colored and weathered. A person's hand is holding the edge of the pallet. The ground is dirt and littered with small debris.
